purpose: Specify reproducible, comparable measurement protocols for all eight SOI outcome workstreams; do not treat source suggestions as extracted observations

methodology.baseline: At least one pre-event observation plus post-event observations, ideally 3-year comparable window
methodology.units: Normalize units, currency base year, destination, definition and source vintage
methodology.causality: State contemporaneous shocks, counterfactual and attribution uncertainty
methodology.economics: Separate gross trade values, government receipts, private revenue, profit and national net benefit
methodology.strategic: Separate legal access, physical delivery, force posture and independently verified operational outcomes
methodology.deduplication: One underlying observation counts once across multiple workstreams
methodology.scoring: No net influence score until independently measured outcomes, costs, attribution, counterfactual and normalization are sufficient

primarySeries: NATO defense expenditure by country, constant prices
Finland/Sweden military readiness and deployed force capabilities
protocols.comparison: Finland and Sweden 2019–2025, compare pre/post accession, separate NATO membership count from readiness

primarySeries: Eurostat EU direct investment positions and flows with China
China MOFCOM bilateral investment flow statistics
protocols.comparison: 2017–2025 bilateral FDI stocks/flows; agreement never ratified so no foregone investment may be imputed without counterfactual
gates: Control for pandemic and Chinese regulatory changes
Avoid valuing hypothetical treaty benefits as realized losses

primarySeries: USITC DataWeb import values by HS and country
protocols.comparison: Matched tariff implementation dates and pre/post import values with product-level counterfactual
gates: Separate tariff revenue from national net benefit

primarySeries: Eurostat EU imports by energy product and origin
Russian export revenues with price and destination breakdown
protocols.comparison: Matched physical volumes and unit values 2021–2025 by product and destination
gates: Do not equate EU market loss with global export loss

primarySeries: UN/WHO assessed and voluntary contributions by year
Treaty membership and formal participation records
protocols.comparison: Annual participation, voting rights and actual contributions before/after effective withdrawal
Same border sectors before/after 2017 and 2024 arrangements
gates: Separate official statements from independently verified access
Avoid treating one sector as entire border

primarySeries: Australian defense portfolio budget and program expenditures
Eurostat import volumes by origin and product
EIA/DOE LNG export destinations, volumes and FOB prices
IEA oil and gas trade flows
protocols.comparison: Destination-specific volume, price, and matching product/time 2017–2026
gates: FOB export prices not realized net revenue
